sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Live, non-permeabilized HEK293T cells surface-labeled with anti-Flag antibody: detectable surface immunofluorescence confirmed membrane-associated receptor display (PMC3698168).
sites.rationale: OR2C3 has no signal peptide; the topology landmarks place residues 1–26 extracellular and TM1 beginning at residue 27. The paper (PMC3698168) describes Flag and Rho tags prepended in-frame at the N-terminus of the full-length, membrane-anchored receptor, and L2 directly confirms surface display by live-cell non-permeabilized immunofluorescence. Because the paper names no specific residue number, the position is topology-derived: with exactly one extracellular terminus and no signal peptide, insert_after_residue=0 (prepend before M1) is the only consistent placement. Python verification: seq[0]='M', confirming residue_after='M'. Full-length OR2C3 expressed in HEK293T cells with N-terminal Flag and Rho tags ligated in-frame upstream of the OR coding sequence; no signal peptide is present, so the extracellular N-terminus (residues 1–26, confirmed by topology landmarks) is the sole extracellular terminus and the only possible location for the described N-terminal tag.

sources.claim: Live, non-permeabilized HEK 293T cells were surface labeled with a Flag antibody to detect membrane associated receptor and OR surface expression was scored based on detectable surface immunofluorescence.

literature_notes: All three ledger lines (L1, L2, L3) derive from the same study (PMC3698168) and describe the same N-terminal tag site on OR2C3. L2 is the most probative because it directly reports surface detection of the tagged receptor by live-cell immunofluorescence. L1 and L3 corroborate the construct design (Flag + 22-aa Rho tag prepended in-frame). No residue number is stated in any clip, but OR2C3 lacks a signal peptide and has exactly one extracellular terminus (residues 1–26), making the N-terminal prepend (insert_after_residue=0) the unambiguous placement. No ledger evidence supports any internal loop tag (ECL1 81–98, ECL2 168–197, ECL3 262–273) or C-terminal tag. No functional (cAMP/calcium signaling) assay result is reported in the ledger clips, so validation_level is surface_only. The Rho tag (L3) is also an N-terminal prepend at the same junction; it is subsumed into this single site rather than listed separately because it is the same position in the same construct family.
